Package meta1

Class IndexStorageBarrel

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
meta1.IndexStorageBarrel
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Remote, RMIBarrelsInterface
public class IndexStorageBarrel extends UnicastRemoteObject implements RMIBarrelsInterface
The `IndexStorageBarrel` class represents a barrel that stores and manages indexed data. It extends the `UnicastRemoteObject` class and implements the `RMIBarrelsInterface` interface. This class provides methods for retrieving URLs based on search terms, sorting URLs by relevance, retrieving short quotes from URLs, retrieving page titles, and finding pages that link to a given URL. It also contains inner classes and data structures for storing and processing data.

    • main

      public static void main(String[] args)
      The main method is the entry point of the program. It loads the configurations, creates a multicast socket, starts multiple threads, and receives messages from downloaders and other barrels.
      Parameters:
      args - The command line arguments. The first argument is the barrel ID, and the second argument is the path to the configuration file.
